name: Speko

team.summary: Bek is the founder and YC S26 participant, with four years of prior experience as co-founder and CTO building voice agents for enterprises across Asia.

evidence.quote: Hi HN! I'm Bek, founder of Speko, a platform that finds an optimal combination of speech-to-text
Before founding Speko, I spent four years as cofounder and CTO building voice agents for enterprises across Asia in 10+ languages.

product.summary: Speko is a router and evaluation platform for voice AI that dynamically selects and connects speech-to-text, LLM, and text-to-speech models via an API or open-source gateway.

evidence.quote: a platform that finds an optimal combination of speech-to-text, LLM, and text-to-speech models, given your constraints
The Router for Voice AI. Every speech model, benchmarked language by language, wired into one API.

size_hint.summary: The market encompasses developers and enterprises building voice agents, with external usage growing about 25 percent per week since late June.

evidence.quote: Since we started the batch in late June, external usage has grown about 25 percent per week on average

competitors.summary: Commenters noted potential overlap with LiveKit Gateway, Vapi, and existing evaluation tools like LM Arena and Artificial Analysis.

evidence.quote: What is the difference with Livekit Gateway? https://livekit.com/blog/introducing-livekit-inference Or even something more managed like Vapi?
evidence.author: MikhailTal

evidence.quote: There are many companies now with evals as a core business model: LM Arena, Artificial Analysis, Prompt foo
evidence.author: narrationbox

why_now.summary: Rapid expansion of voice model options and frequent vendor updates make manual integration and static stacking obsolete, creating a need for automated routing.

evidence.quote: Each of those layers offers a dozen credible vendors, and each month there are new models on the market. Almost everyone evaluates once, picks a stack of their choice, and never rechecks

risks.risk: Industry shifts toward end-to-end trained omni-models could bypass the multi-vendor STT/LLM/TTS stack architecture.

evidence.quote: The industry is very much moving towards one-model-does-all end to end trained similar to LLMs and VLMs.

risks.risk: Stakeholders often make voice stack decisions only once at the project start, questioning the ongoing value of dynamic routing.

evidence.quote: stakeholders usually make this sort of decisions once at the start of the project.

founder_depth.why: The founder spent four years as a cofounder and CTO building enterprise voice agents across multiple languages before launching Speko.

evidence.quote: Before founding Speko, I spent four years as cofounder and CTO building voice agents for enterprises across Asia in 10+ languages.

shipping_evidence.why: The product features a live hosted router, open-sourced gateway binary under MIT, and published multilingual benchmark boards.

evidence.quote: We also open sourced the gateway for teams who want to avoid an extra network hop... ( https://github.com/SpekoAI/gateway , MIT): one Go binary
Every speech model, benchmarked language by language, wired into one API.

demand_signal.why: External usage has grown 25% per week since late June, and customer anecdotes indicate early adoption, though revenue figures are not disclosed.

evidence.quote: Since we started the batch in late June, external usage has grown about 25 percent per week on average
A team running thousands of calls a day told us: "we can literally go to this dashboard, switch the model, and it will do it for us."

defensibility.why: Moat relies on proprietary evaluation methodologies and benchmark test suites for spontaneous speech and naturalness, though basic routing logic can be replicated.

evidence.quote: We trained an automatic scorer for TTS naturalness on our blind head-to-head listening votes

analysis.thesis_fit_reason: Speko is an AI infrastructure and developer tool providing a model router and evaluation API for voice agents, used by software engineering teams building AI applications, who pay for hosted routing and managed keys.
analysis.case_summary: Strong technical founder with deep domain experience and live open-source infra, but faces strategic risk from the industry trend toward end-to-end native voice models.
would_change_my_mind: Evidence that end-to-end multimodal voice models completely replace multi-vendor architectures
Data showing net retention and recurring paid contracts from production teams
Proof that automated benchmark routing significantly outperforms static enterprise selections
data_gaps: Exact revenue or paying customer count
Granular architecture details of the automated scoring engine
Retention metrics beyond the initial 25% weekly growth claim
